story.headline: The rocks Perseverance found. The path humans will walk.
paragraphs: In 2024 Perseverance cored a rock called Cheyava Falls on the edge of an ancient river channel in Jezero Crater. In September 2025 NASA reported its “leopard spots” as a potential biosignature — the strongest candidate sign of ancient life found on Mars so far. A rover cannot settle the question.

Your mission: walk to it. CAIRN layers data from four NASA missions and the USGS into one map, finds the safest route for a person in a spacesuit, and gets you back to the rover if the Sun turns on you.
